findings.description: The positional-arguments section now passes every argument's help record straight to write_dl. For an argument with no help text, get_help_record now returns (metavar, None), so the description is None instead of the empty string the old fallback supplied.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with at least one positional argument that has help text and another positional argument with no help. The any() check passes, and write_dl receives a row whose second element is None. The width measurement in write_dl calls term_len on that value, which should raise TypeError. Impact: --help crashes for such commands instead of listing the arguments. This is a common command shape, so it is a crash on a common path.
